name: contract-initial-page-viewports
goal: Generate the initial page screenshot state at desktop, tablet and mobile without losing its existing behavior

evidence: New app and game plans emit only one initial-page screenshot despite the declared three-viewport page contract. Declare desktop 1440x900, tablet 920x800 and mobile 390x844 for this existing state before adding the two missing viewport cases.

The existing app-plan case checks screenshot presence but not viewport coverage. Strengthen that case and exact child-matrix counts; preserve its title, all parent cases, console monitoring, missing-baseline refusal and full-page matching.
